description: This file defines an interface 'AcknowledgementConfig' in Java, which provides configuration methods related to acknowledgements in the system. It includes method signatures for getting timeouts, lifetimes, and size limits, along with an internal enum 'AcknowledgementConfigValue' that specifies configuration keys and default values.

classes.name: AcknowledgementConfig
classes.description: An interface providing configuration settings for acknowledgements, including timeout durations, lifetimes, and maximum acknowledgment size. It also contains an enum 'AcknowledgementConfigValue' for configuration key-value pairs.

classes.name: AcknowledgementConfig.AcknowledgementConfigValue
classes.description: An enum defining known configuration path expressions and their default values for AcknowledgementConfig, including timeout and size parameters.

methods.name: getForwarderFallbackTimeout
methods.description: Returns the default timeout used for correlating acknowledgements via the AcknowledgementForwarderActor.

methods.name: getCollectorFallbackLifetime
methods.description: Returns the fallback lifetime for collecting acknowledgements in ResponseCollectorActor.

methods.name: getCollectorFallbackAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout for asking ResponseCollectorActor for its output.

methods.name: getIssuedMaxBytes
methods.description: Returns the maximum payload size in bytes for automatically issued acknowledgements.
